label: Music
depicts: Beamed musical note with two round note heads and one top bar
use_when: Use when the interface wants a double note symbol with a connecting top beam.
avoid_when: Do not use for the single note or circular note icons when two note heads are visible.

label: Music
depicts: Single musical note with one round head and a short flag at the top
use_when: Use when the interface wants one simple music note instead of a beamed pair.
avoid_when: Do not use for the double note or circular note icons when only one note head should show.

label: Music
depicts: Round ring icon with one single note head inside the circle
use_when: Use when the interface wants a music note enclosed inside a circular ring frame.
avoid_when: Do not use for the free standing note icons when the outer ring needs to remain visible.

label: Headphone
depicts: Over ear headphone outline with a round headband and angled ear pads
use_when: Use when the interface wants over ear headphones with a rounded headband and angled pads.
avoid_when: Do not use for the straighter headphone frame when the round headband curve matters.

label: Headphone
depicts: Headphone outline with a tall U shaped band and straight rounded ear pads
use_when: Use when the interface wants headphones with a straighter U shaped band and vertical ear pads.
avoid_when: Do not use for the rounder headphone icon when the tall U band should remain visible.
